entities.name: Mazik
entities.description: A Joraga Elf who grew up in Nissa's village and accompanied her on her quest.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker elf whose spark ignited when she released the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Ashaya
entities.description: Elemental Nissa summoned to save Mazik.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: Mountain region Nissa and Mazik journeyed to.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings imprisoned in the mountain, released by Nissa.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: Dangerous phenomenon that was Zendikar's reaction to the trapped darkness.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: Plane to which Nissa was whisked.

events.summary: Mazik accompanies Nissa from their village; Nissa summons Ashaya to save him from vampires.
events.quote: Nissa instinctively summoned Ashaya for the first time

events.summary: They are caught in a Roil and Nissa stops it with Ashaya.
events.quote: managed to stop the Roil in its tracks through her connection with the land

events.summary: Mazik stays behind at the Teeth of Akoum while Nissa goes on alone.
events.quote: Mazik had to stay behind with Ashaya

events.summary: Nissa releases the Eldrazi and her spark ignites, whisking her to Lorwyn.
events.quote: caused her Planeswalker spark to ignite, whisking her away to Lorwyn

relations.quote: Mazik is a Joraga Elf that grew up in the same village as Nissa .
